text:
sam: Hi all — running the terraform quickstart (provider v0.3) in our CI to auto-provision an org+workspace plus run the JS SDK smoke test. Workspace appears in Console and payment method attached, but the SDK call fails with 402. Anyone seen this flow break for CI?
ela: curious, does Console show any banners or steps under Billing? sometimes theres an extra confirmation required.
sam: Console says active, but the API response is: 
```
HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{
  \"error\": \"billing_contact_confirmation_required\",
  \"message\": \"Confirm billing contact before enabling API access. See Console > Billing or use the billing confirm API.\"
}
```
infra-bot: note: org auto-created by terraform provider marked: require_billing_contact_confirmation=true (safety policy).
devex: ah — we rolled out that safety guard last sprint to prevent accidental charges for infra-provisioned orgs. The quickstart examples weren't updated to include the post-create confirmation step.
sam: is there a supported API to do the confirm so CI can proceed without human clicks?
devex: yes. infra flows should POST to /api/v1/orgs/{org_id}/billing/confirm. Example (requires org-admin token):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST \"https://console.redwood.inference/api/v1/orgs/<ORG_ID>/billing/confirm\" \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_ADMIN_TOKEN\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{\"contact_email\":\"infra+ci@example.com\",\"contact_name\":\"Infra CI\",\"accepted_terms\":true}'
```
ela: we could add a `null_resource` local-exec in the quickstart TF that runs that POST after org creation. would be a minimal documented workaround.
ops: long term, maybe the provider should expose something like `auto_confirm_billing_contact = \"sandbox-only\"` to opt-in for test orgs. must be gated.
devex: agreed. followups: (1) update quickstart TF to show a local-exec snippet, (2) add a provider issue to add an explicit flag `auto_confirm_billing_contact_for_testing`, (3) update SDK error docs to mention `billing_contact_confirmation_required` and link to the confirm endpoint.
billing-bot: Billing state for org <ORG_ID>: PENDING_CONTACT_CONFIRMATION. No invoices or charges. To enable API: confirm billing contact in Console or via API. For automation outside sandbox, contact billing-team@redwood.com.
sam: local-exec workaround fixed CI; SDK smoke test now gets 200. I'll open a PR to quickstart examples and the internal infra repo.
devex: thanks — please also add a short note in the SDK's error-message mapping so the client surfaces a helpful link in the exception for this status. That will reduce future confusion.
ela: thanks, Sam. tagging this thread as the record for the workaround and assigned followups. :)
